title: Dynatrace Agentic Guide Scenario
description: Manifest for a single demo scenario. One file per scenario; zero engine changes to add a new one.

id.description: Kebab-case, matches the parent directory name.

source_guide.description: UUID of the originating video guide JSON (provenance, not a runtime dependency).

duration_minutes.description: [min, max] expected duration for a typical run.

services.description: Dynatrace service entity IDs the demo is scoped to.

segment.description: Dynatrace filter segment ID to scope queries.

data_objects.description: DQL data objects the hook permits for this scenario.

timeframe.description: How to determine the query timeframe. 'derived_from_problem' = resolver output.

query.description: Path to the DQL file that finds the live problem. Relative to scenario dir.

business_context.description: Used by the ambient discovery flow to frame the scenario as a live incident.

discovery_hook.description: Template string with {placeholders} for affected_users, duration_min, revenue_impact, failure_rate, service_name, user_action.

objective.description: What the user should understand by the end of this beat.

evidence.description: Paths to DQL files that produce the evidence for this beat. Each runs independently via tools/preflight.py run-query — no dependency between them.

chained_evidence.description: Evidence queries that need a value discovered from an earlier query in THIS beat's `evidence` list — e.g. a trace ID found by one query, fed into a second query that expands it. See docs/AUTHORING.md 'Chained evidence' and skills/dynatrace-playground/SKILL.md for the mechanism (tools/preflight.py run-query ... --var KEY=VALUE).

query.description: Path to the dependent DQL file. Must reference {{var_name}} as a placeholder.

depends_on.description: Path to the query (must be in this beat's `evidence` list) whose result supplies the value.

extract_field.description: Field name to read from depends_on's FIRST record.

var_name.description: Placeholder name the extracted value is injected as, e.g. TRACE_ID for {{TRACE_ID}}.

reveal.description: The insight the beat delivers (internal to the engine; not shown verbatim).

success.description: What user output signals they've grasped the beat (for engine to detect).

nudges.description: Optional. The engine always narrates its own read of the evidence rather than withholding it (see skills/demo-engine/SKILL.md). 'invite' means it's worth an optional one-turn guess-invite first, on top of narrating regardless — it is never a gate the user must pass to advance. Omit entirely to just narrate directly, which is the default and normal case.

deep_link.description: URL template from the source guide JSON, with {{PLACEHOLDER}} variables.

source_step_id.description: UUID of the originating step in the source guide JSON (provenance).

peak_moment.description: Marks this beat as a climax/payoff moment the engine should stage distinctly rather than present as an ordinary evidence table. See the 'staging' field for how.

staging.description: Pacing/delivery instructions for a peak_moment beat — how to land the finding, not what the finding is (that's 'reveal').
